reviews.author: Reddit account not captured in the research snapshot
reviews.report: A student sought an X API alternative because project access and budget were limiting factors.
reviews.crossCheck: The current provider page confirms resource pricing. The forum report does not prove a price or billing outcome.
reviews.limitations: Forum request, not a measured service review.

reviews.author: Moriss RC
reviews.report: The reviewer described simple integration, good value, and quick help.
reviews.crossCheck: The pricing page confirms the current plan and credit structure. Support quality remains a customer report.
reviews.limitations: One review cannot establish reliability or support quality.

reviews.author: Mitchey
reviews.report: The reviewer liked the price but reported unstable responses, data errors, and weak follow-up.
reviews.crossCheck: The provider documents request behavior. The reported instability and help experience remain unverified customer claims.
reviews.limitations: Single negative report with a dispute noted on the review page.

reviews.author: Andrew M.
reviews.report: The reviewer found setup easy but said the sample-size control appeared late in the purchase flow.
reviews.crossCheck: The provider page confirms result pricing. It does not settle the reported purchase-flow visibility issue.
reviews.limitations: Reviewer received access without the normal charge.

reviews.author: Reddit account not captured in the research snapshot
reviews.report: The author reported runs exceeding configured limits, higher spend, stale results, and inconsistent behavior.
reviews.crossCheck: Apify documents resource-based platform charges. The report does not identify the API Dojo Tweet Scraper version or request settings.
reviews.limitations: Apify platform report that may describe another Actor.

reviews.author: Mikael Jacob
reviews.report: The reviewer said the X API worked consistently during their use.
reviews.crossCheck: The provider documents the X API product. No dated uptime method supports the reviewer's experience as a general rate.

reviews.author: Cardy Tang
reviews.report: The reviewer liked price and stability but reported latency spikes and a missed repeat-repost event.
reviews.crossCheck: The current pricing page supports the unit price used in the model. The event and latency reports need a measured test.
reviews.limitations: One monitoring workload and no reproducible request log.

reviews.author: John
reviews.report: The reviewer reported unreliable extraction and unhelpful support.
reviews.crossCheck: The documentation defines the product contract but cannot confirm the customer's incident.
reviews.limitations: One negative report without request evidence.

reviews.author: Arvind K.
reviews.report: The reviewer described predictable pricing, easy integration, and HTML output that still needed parsing.
reviews.crossCheck: The provider page confirms feature-based credit multipliers. The review is not an X-specific output test.

reviews.author: Arvind K.
reviews.report: The former customer reported an unexpected tenfold cost increase before switching providers.
reviews.crossCheck: The current page confirms plan limits and feature-dependent credits. It does not verify the historical account charge.
reviews.limitations: Report appears inside a review of another service.

reviews.author: Bairro C.
reviews.report: The reviewer found basic no-code extraction easy but wanted more filtering and cleanup control.
reviews.crossCheck: The current plan page confirms product tiers. The older review may not reflect current filters.
reviews.limitations: Small review sample and an older product version.

reviews.author: Simon G.
reviews.report: The reviewer praised data quality and team responsiveness.
reviews.crossCheck: The pricing page confirms current billing options. Quality and help remain subjective reports.
reviews.limitations: Small review sample and no X-specific request evidence.

reviews.author: Jonathan H.
reviews.report: The reviewer reported a large overage, limited request logs, and weak spend controls.
reviews.crossCheck: RapidAPI documents usage dashboards and per-listing plans. The report concerns the marketplace, not Twitter API45.

reviews.author: Alexey
reviews.report: The reviewer reported subscribing to a nonworking listing and difficulty resolving it through platform support.
reviews.crossCheck: The listing defines its own plan. The review concerns a different unnamed API and cannot judge Twitter API45.

reviews.author: Mariam M.
reviews.report: The reviewer praised scaling and support but mentioned missing screenshot support at that time.
reviews.crossCheck: The current pricing page confirms plan and feature multipliers. The feature comment is stale and excluded from comparison claims.
reviews.limitations: Older review; product features may have changed.

reviews.author: Validated reviewer in information technology
reviews.report: The reviewer described quick setup and steady operation, while noting harder cost prediction at high volume.
reviews.crossCheck: The current pricing page confirms request and feature rates. It supports recalculating by exact workload, not the subjective experience.
reviews.limitations: General scraping workload and unnamed reviewer.

reviews.author: DM
reviews.report: The reviewer described reliable scaling and responsive help over 6 months.
reviews.crossCheck: The provider page confirms success-based credits. Reliability and help remain customer reports.
reviews.limitations: One customer report and no X-specific output test.
